kram-p01-v01.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p01-v01.question: What rite ends sorrow?
premises: Completion-rite amid sorrow's host, in spreading bliss-taste, on a foul day.
By mutual doing, in the weighty Lord's hymn (uneven-flame scorcher), mind ever mirrors back.
Seal: fear gone.
kram-p01-v01.inference: The hymn mirrors back the fearful mind into fearlessness.

kram-p02-v02.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p02-v02.question: How is hymning effortless?
premises: Examined self examines again the hymned conduct; worshipper presents in hymn amid difference-taken-as-one.
Examined self at every object-knowing moment: 'thus in Your hymn I stand here always, effortless.'

kram-p03-v03.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p03-v03.question: What if the self goes unscrutinized?
premises: Unscrutinized self never shares thing-knowing; unscrutinized, without grasping-course, it is not.
But Śiva — that self shining, one sap of all things — hence I, heart-devoted, ever blissful in Your hymn.
kram-p03-v03.inference: Unscrutinized, no knowing; scrutinized, Śiva shining one-sapped — bliss.

kram-p04-v04.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice, addressing heart)
kram-p04-v04.question: O heart, what now?
premises: By varied birth-wandering gears, omniscience gained — O heart — effortlessly by You.
That within, in teaching-spread-course-become light: clearly in speech obtained — show the Lord's hymn now.
kram-p04-v04.inference: Omniscience gained effortlessly; heart bidden to show the hymn in speech.

kram-p05-v05.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice, intoxicated)
kram-p05-v05.question: What does the shaken-off sing?
premises: Shaking off bond-conceit-path-standing, relishing this, difference burnt in endless praise-fire.
From varied self-swelling glory's rushing start, drinking things — O giver — mad-drunk am I, blissful.
kram-p05-v05.inference: Bond burnt, glory rushed, things drunk: madness-bliss sings.

kram-p06-v06.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice, questioning)
kram-p06-v06.question: If the heart holds His conduct, how hymn — and by what means?
premises: Be the heart holds the Lord's varied conduct — if so, how would hymning be done? Yet done it is, by that, suddenly.
On Śiva-oneness gained, Śiva-bowing is the first means.
kram-p06-v06.inference: Held conduct unhymnable yet hymned: sudden Śiva-bowing, first means.
uncertainties: yadi-tataḥ-kathaṃ chain kept as staged perplexity.

kram-p07-v07.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p07-v07.question: What body has fire apart from burning?
premises: Flame-formed, ripening-glorious: burning shown, other of fire shed — what body holds at all?
Answer: I praise knowing-rays; if own-each by that praised, none else is the Lord's power.
kram-p07-v07.inference: Fire apart from burning is nobodies: praise knowing-rays, each-owned.
uncertainties: Rhetorical kim api kept; nijanijān distributive.

kram-p08-v08.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p08-v08.question: What taste has the beginningless?
premises: In varied beginningness, melted rule: what taste from partitionlessness — supreme fullness unequalled?
Answer: self's light-yoking, all-thing-oneness, by unopposed dharma-floods: supreme knowing, priceless-fit-qualified (SD aviruddhair).
kram-p08-v08.inference: Partitionless taste, unopposed floods: supreme knowing priceless.
uncertainties: aviruddhair SD over print viruddhair (sense requires unopposed).

kram-p09-v09.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p09-v09.question: How shall heart and speech hymn difference-gone form?
premises: Thus in such forms, giver, varied Your form shines — in own-portion this world, difference gone, of the Lord.
May heart to praise that same, and outer-speech-instrument songs, mine constantly, unabandoned-rush.
kram-p09-v09.inference: Difference-gone form shines; heart-and-speech vowed unabandoned.

kram-p10-v10.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p10-v10.question: What rises-sets at once within You alone?
premises: Within You-alone-one, throbbing-glory knowledge-ocean, wave-taste spreading by own taste.
They — creations-keepings-dissolvings-formed, moon-sun-fire clash-gleams at once: rise-set powers (SD tavaikasyāntaḥ variant).
kram-p10-v10.inference: Ocean within; moon-sun-fire rise-set at once.
uncertainties: Print tavaivaikasyāntaḥ followed; SD variant noted.

kram-p11-v11.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p11-v11.question: Where shall the heart fix?
premises: The Lord's power, enjoying varied-unvaried-course and beyond-difference stations, ever goes, never into division, nohow.
So on this unagitated ground — Your step it is — may my heart-ground grow one-pointed, Bhairava Lord.
kram-p11-v11.inference: Power walks undivided; heart prays one-pointed on still ground.

kram-p12-v12.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p12-v12.question: How does freedom meet difference?
premises: From the complete Whole — oh, joy-taste juice — You lead Your own power into difference, by will's spreading.
Priceless Your freedom — praising Your wonder-become power, fear melted, I am Śiva-made.
kram-p12-v12.inference: Whole leads power into difference; praise melts fear into Śiva-made.

kram-p13-v13.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p13-v13.question: How stand that form?
premises: Thisness-just Your form, Lord, power-juiced; by sequencelessness itself time-reckoning forcibly melted.
By mind-power, speech too, sense-wheels, pots outside — may I stand that form at once, unceasing.
kram-p13-v13.inference: Thisness-form power-juiced; sequencelessness melts time; all instruments at once.

kram-p14-v14.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p14-v14.question: How become triple-formed?
premises: You swell sequence on that ground, mete Your powers' difference — show always in Yourself, O god.
Then named doing-knowing-willing, maintenance-dissolution-great-emission-powered, three-formed — may I become, for overlying, eager-hearted.
kram-p14-v14.inference: He swells and shows; prayer to become triple for overlaying.

kram-p15-v15.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p15-v15.question: Where shall emission sport?
premises: Before, emission dissolved, fire-made — where would it shine, facing beyond-joy? Moon-touch-lovely it goes.
O Bhairava Lord — may this emission-named of Yours sport always in my mind.
kram-p15-v15.inference: Dissolved emission questioned; moon-lovely answer; ever-sport prayed.

kram-p16-v16.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p16-v16.question: How red?
premises: In emitted thing-share outside, in extreme taste-bliss, You resort by rush to redness-made.
Then red goddess, Yours in all things — make me, by red-drinking-order-joined conclave, past-loathing.
kram-p16-v16.inference: Rush to redness; past-loathing in red rite prayed.
uncertainties: ghṛṇā double sense (loathing/compassion) held; nanu as prayer-particle.

kram-p17-v17.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p17-v17.question: What shall the goddess grasp?
premises: To quit outer work, dwell in noble knowing-ground; show thing-nondifference, waves gone fickle.
Goddess grasps maintenance's end; may she ever grasp my wandering state's undoing, Lord.
kram-p17-v17.inference: Quit outer, dwell noble, show undivided; grasp ends — maintenance's and mine.

kram-p18-v18.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p18-v18.question: How is world-fear ground?
premises: Wishing calm by world-loosing: rule of doubt-fear, then ban — shown; Yama emitted.
Splitting doubt again — may the great goddess grind my world-fear.
kram-p18-v18.inference: Rule-then-ban shown, Yama made, doubt split: grind world-fear.

kram-p19-v19.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p19-v19.question: What survives melting?
premises: Doubt-heap melted, conduct gone, glory gone, rule gone — all melted.
Hunger remains: to gulp the endless feast — strike, dissolution-named, my heart's split part.
kram-p19-v19.inference: All melted but hunger: strike prayed.

kram-p20-v20.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p20-v20.question: Who makes death-dissolution?
premises: By goddesses at once, difference-glory split — thought-living one shines, knower-standing. Enough.
Considered in own heart, dissolution-formed, gracious — my death-loosing maker, blessed Lady.
kram-p20-v20.inference: Goddesses split difference; thought shines; considered maker gracious.

kram-p21-v21.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p21-v21.question: What do the three ordain?
premises: So your three, by own-power-expanse-force obtained, six-wheel-course-made-step powers these.
By order, by unfolding, they ordain varied world-state; by these goddesses, devoted-hearted may I be, fear-gone.
kram-p21-v21.inference: Three obtained ordain by unfolding; devotee prays fear-gone by them.

kram-p22-v22.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p22-v22.question: What ground holds, and what conduct sports?
premises: This ground she holds — world-fear-splitting-dread-making; this wake-one-pointed-melted-taste-formed — ordained too.
So holding, melting, wiping inauspicious stretches, as-pleased conduct resorted — may she sport in my heart.
kram-p22-v22.inference: Ground held dread-making; conduct as-pleased sporting in heart prayed.

kram-p23-v23.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p23-v23.question: What draws the sap, and what thins difference?
premises: On limited step, measurer's step gained, its spread by own-own gleam contracting — she who draws the all-sap of the station-yoked day-sun (mārtaṇḍasya normalized).
Drawing forcibly — may she thin my difference from world-fear.
kram-p23-v23.inference: Sun-sap drawn forcibly; difference thinned from world-fear prayed.

kram-p24-v24.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p24-v24.question: How enter, and how be adorned?
premises: Whole garland, sequenceless, in self again entered — endless-inner-massed-great-ray-heaped.
Supreme, divine-bliss to grasp, noble-eager, gracious to me may she be — heart-path let her adorn. (Second hemistich recovered — T1 gap fixed.)
kram-p24-v24.inference: Garland entered again; gracious heart-path-adornment prayed.

kram-p25-v25.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p25-v25.question: When does the goddess shine Śiva-made?
premises: In proof merged, by Śiva-step-shining-glory-force: body-breath-made, measured-made-knower-standing.
When time-cadre reaches dissolution-step of Yours — then the goddess who shines, mine — she would be Śiva-made.
kram-p25-v25.inference: Measure merged in proof; time-cadre met: shining Śiva-made.

kram-p26-v26.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p26-v26.question: How does cover spread, and time get made?
premises: Manifestation-named consciousness, sequenceless, from void-step, outside-merged — spreads utterly as covering.
Then too in inner-essence, by melted rush, sequencelessly — great Time-goddess, making all time (kalayantī emended; print kalayatāṃ fork live).
kram-p26-v26.inference: Cover spread outside; time made within: Mahākālī.
uncertainties: kalayantī emendation with live fork (print anomalous).

kram-p27-v27.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p27-v27.question: What shall the mind resort?
premises: Then in the goddess in whom supreme-full-standing-enjoying: sequence cut, quickly, standing-minded-taste reflecting —
Proof, knower, measure, whole world this standing embraced — may my mind resort to this consciousness.
kram-p27-v27.inference: Sequence cut in full goddess; all embraced; mind resort prayed.

kram-p28-v28.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p28-v28.question: Whom bow, unobstructed?
premises: Unobstructed, in self-made Lord, in great Lord abide pervading powers.
That power-possessor I venerate — god, churn-named, world-one-essence.

kram-p29-v29.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
kram-p29-v29.question: What grace is asked?
premises: Thus own-power-ray-mass-praise-bonds heard — Lord, if You come to grace:
By that quickly all folk, by own-rule-rays, darkness-masses allayed — make ye.
kram-p29-v29.inference: Heard praise-bonds; grace prayed; all-folk darkness-allayed bidden.

kram-p30-v30.speaker: Abhinavagupta (dating seal, 991 CE)
kram-p30-v30.question: When and by whom was Śiva praised?
premises: In the sixty-sixth year, on the ninth dark day, in Mārgaśīrṣa —
By me Abhinavagupta, Śiva was praised (colophon third-person, excluded).
kram-p30-v30.inference: Dated seal: 66th year, 9th dark, Mārgaśīrṣa, Abhinavagupta.
uncertainties: Laukika 66 = 991 CE per research; colophon excluded as scribal.

kram-p01-v01.plain_english: This is the completion-rite amid sorrow's host — in the spreading taste of great bliss-essence, this foul day: for by mutual doing, in the hymn of the Lord, weighty with scorching uneven flames, the mind constantly reflects back — its fear gone.
kram-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: duḥkhavrātavrataparigame pāraṇavidhir | mahāsaukhyāsāraprasaraṇarase durdinam idam | pratiphalati ceto gatabhayam

kram-p02-v02.plain_english: Having examined own self, examining again the hymned conduct, the worshipper sets it forth in hymn amid difference-held-as-one. The examined self, at every moment of object-knowing: thus in Your hymn I stand here always — effortless.
kram-p02-v02.sanskrit_cite: vimṛśya svātmānaṃ vimṛśati punaḥ stutyacaritaṃ | nikhilaviṣayajñānasamaye taditthaṃ tvatstotre 'ham iha satataṃ yatnarahitaḥ

kram-p03-v03.plain_english: Unscrutinized, the self never comes to share in thing-knowing; unscrutinized, it is not at all without the grasping course. But Śiva — that self shining, one sap of all things — hence I, heart-devoted to Your hymn, am ever blissful.
kram-p03-v03.sanskrit_cite: anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmā na hi bhavati bhāvapramitibhāj | śivaś cāsau svātmā sphurad akhilabhāvaikasarasas

kram-p04-v04.plain_english: By varied birth-and-wandering gears, omniscience is gained — O heart — effortlessly through You. That within, become light in the teaching's spreading course: clearly obtained in speech — show forth the Lord's hymn now.
kram-p04-v04.sanskrit_cite: jātyādibhramaṇaparipāṭīparikarair avāptam sārvajñaṃ hṛdaya | tvadbodhaprasarasaraṇībhūtamahasi sphuṭam vāci prāpya prakaṭaya vibhoḥ stotram adhunā

kram-p05-v05.plain_english: Shaking off the standing of bondage-conceit-paths, relishing this, with difference burnt in the fire of endless praise — from the rushing start of varied self-swelling shining glory, drinking things — O giver — mad-intoxicated am I, blissful.

kram-p06-v06.plain_english: Be — the heart holds the varied conduct of the Lord famed vast-lordly, many-powered. If so, how would hymning be done? Yet it is done — by that, suddenly. On gaining Śiva-oneness, Śiva-bowing is the first means.
kram-p06-v06.sanskrit_cite: hṛdayam adhiśete yadi tataḥ | kathaṃ stotraṃ kuryād | śivaikātmyaprāptau śivanatir upāyaḥ prathamakaḥ

kram-p07-v07.plain_english: Flame-formed, gloriously ripening: burning displayed, the other of fire shed — what body at all holds? Indeed none. I praise the rays of knowing: if each-own by that praised, none else at all becomes the Lord's power.
kram-p07-v07.sanskrit_cite: jvaladrūpaṃ bhāsvatpacanam atha dāhaṃ prakaṭanam | stuve saṃvidraśmīn yadi nijanijāṃs tena sa nuto

kram-p08-v08.plain_english: In varied beginningness, in melted rule: what taste — from partitionlessness, supreme fullness unequalled? The self's yoking of lights, all-being-thing-oneness, by unopposed dharma-floods: supreme knowing, priceless-fit-qualified.
kram-p08-v08.sanskrit_cite: vicitrārambhatve galitaniyame yaḥ kila rasaḥ | sakalabhavabhāvaikamayatāviruddhair dharmaughaiḥ paracitir anarghocitaguṇā

kram-p09-v09.plain_english: Thus in such forms, giver, varied indeed Your form shines — in own portion, in this world, difference gone, of the Lord. To praise that same, may heart, and songs of outer speech-instruments, be mine constantly, in unabandoned rush.
kram-p09-v09.sanskrit_cite: vividhaṃ te kila vapur vibhāti svāṃśe | tad evaitatstotuṃ hṛdayam atha gīrbāhyakaraṇaprabandhāś

kram-p10-v10.plain_english: Within You-alone-one, of throbbing glory, of the knowledge-ocean, the taste of varied wave-masses spreading by own taste — they indeed, these creation-keeping-dissolving-formed ones, of moon-sun-fires' clash-gleams, at once are rise-and-set powers.
kram-p10-v10.sanskrit_cite: tavaivaikasyāntaḥ sphuritamahaso | sṛṣṭisthitilayamaya sphūrjitarucāṃ śaśāṅkārkāgnīnāṃ yugapad udayāpāyavibhavāḥ

kram-p11-v11.plain_english: Hence the Lord's power — enjoying varied, unvaried, beyond-difference stations — ever goes, never into division, nohow. So on this unagitated ground — Your step it is — may my heart-ground grow one-pointed, Bhairava Lord.
kram-p11-v11.sanskrit_cite: vibhoḥ śaktiḥ śaśvad vrajati na vibhedaṃ katham api | tadekāgrībhūyān mama hṛdayabhūr bhairava vibho

kram-p12-v12.plain_english: From that complete Whole — oh, juice of great-joy-taste — You lead Your own power into difference, by Your will's spreading. Priceless Your freedom — praising this, Your utterly wonderful becoming-power, fear melted, I am Śiva-made.
kram-p12-v12.sanskrit_cite: nijāṃ śaktiṃ bhedaṃ gamayasi nijecchāprasarataḥ | anarghaṃ svātantryaṃ tava

kram-p13-v13.plain_english: Thisness-just Your form, O Lord, power-juiced — by sequencelessness itself forcibly melted is time-reckoning. By mind-power, by speech too, then by sense-wheels outside, then by pot and the rest — may I stand that form at once, unceasing.
kram-p13-v13.sanskrit_cite: idantāvad rūpaṃ tava bhagavataḥ śaktisarasaṃ | tadrūpaṃ yugapad adhitiṣṭheyam aniśam

kram-p14-v14.plain_english: Making sequence-swelling on that ground, measuring difference of own powers — O god, You show always in own self. Then, named doing-knowing-willing, maintenance-dissolution-great-emission-powered, three-formed — may I become, for overlying, eager-hearted.
kram-p14-v14.sanskrit_cite: kramollāsaṃ tasyāṃ bhuvi viracayan | trirūpaṃ bhūyāsaṃ samadhiśayituṃ vyagrahṛdayaḥ

kram-p15-v15.plain_english: Before, emission dissolved, fire-made — where would it shine, facing beyond-joy? It goes, moon-touch-lovely, sharing fire-moon-expanse-both-power. O Bhairava Lord — may this emission-named of Yours sport always in my mind.
kram-p15-v15.sanskrit_cite: purā sṛṣṭir līnā hutavahamayī | taveyaṃ sṛṣṭyākhyā mama manasi nityaṃ vilasatām

kram-p16-v16.plain_english: In the emitted thing-share, outside, in extreme taste-bliss — when there indeed You resort by rush to redness-made — then, red goddess, Yours in all things — make me, by red-drinking-order-joined conclave, past loathing.
kram-p16-v16.sanskrit_cite: yadā tatraiva tvaṃ bhajasi rabhasād raktimayatām | kriyād raktāpānakramaghaṭitagoṣṭhīgataghṛṇam

kram-p17-v17.plain_english: To leave outer activity, to dwell in noble consciousness-ground — when You show thing-nondifference, waves gone fickle — the goddess grasps maintenance's destruction. Then may she, Yours, Lord, grasp ever my wandering state's undoing.
kram-p17-v17.sanskrit_cite: bahir vṛttiṃ hātuṃ citibhuvam udārāṃ nivasituṃ | sthiteḥ sāṃsārikyāḥ kalayatu vināśaṃ mama sadā

kram-p18-v18.plain_english: Wishing calm by world-dissolution, by own rush — the rule named own-doubt-fear, then the prohibition, You show. Having emitted Yama, You split doubt again and again — may the great goddess grind my world-fear.
kram-p18-v18.sanskrit_cite: jagatsaṃhāreṇa praśamayitukāmaḥ | mahādevī seyaṃ mama bhavabhayaṃ saṃdalayatām

kram-p19-v19.plain_english: In melted doubt-heap, at once in full glory, with world-conduct gone, melted glory, scripture-rule gone — to swallow the endless enjoyable flood all around, greedy-juiced — O Lord named dissolution — strike my heart's split portion.
kram-p19-v19.sanskrit_cite: vilīne śaṅkaughe sapadi paripūrṇe ca vibhave | saṃhārākhyā mama hṛdi bhidāṃśaṃ praharatu

kram-p20-v20.plain_english: So by goddesses at once, in split difference-glory, thought-life-one shines forth — knower-standing, enough. Hence in own heart considered dissolution-share, standing-formed, gracious may she be — my death-dissolution-maker, blessed Lady.
kram-p20-v20.sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ devībhiḥ sapadi dalite bhedavibhave | mṛtyupralayakaraṇī me bhagavatī

kram-p21-v21.plain_english: So thus your three, by own-power-expanse-force obtained — six-wheel-course-made-step powers these. By order, by unfolding, they ordain varied world-state; by these goddesses, devoted-hearted may I be, fear-gone.
kram-p21-v21.sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ te tisro nijavibhavavisphāraṇavaśād | kramād unmeṣeṇa pravidadhati citrāṃ bhavadaśām

kram-p22-v22.plain_english: This ground she holds — world-fear-splitting-dread-making; this wake-one-pointed-melted-taste-formed — ordained too. So holding, melting, wiping inauspicious stretches, as-pleased conduct resorted — may she sport in my heart.
kram-p22-v22.sanskrit_cite: imāṃ rundhe bhūmiṃ bhavabhayabhidātaṅkakaraṇīm | bhajati lasatāṃ sā mama hṛdi

kram-p23-v23.plain_english: Of doing-mind-loss and the rest, on the limited step, the measurer's step of the gained — its spread contracting by own-own gleam — she who draws the all-sap of the station-yoked day-sun. Drawing forcibly — may she thin my difference from world-fear.
kram-p23-v23.sanskrit_cite: sphāraṃ nijanijarucā saṃharati yā | iyaṃ mārta.ṅdasya sthitipadayujaḥ sāram akhilam

kram-p24-v24.plain_english: Whole garland, sequenceless, in self again entered — endless-inner-massed-great-ray-heaped. Supreme, divine-bliss to grasp, noble-eager, gracious to me may she be — heart-path let her adorn.
kram-p24-v24.sanskrit_cite: samagrām akṣālīṃ kramavirahitā sātmani muhur | prasannā me bhūyāt hṛdayapadavīṃ bhūṣayatu ca

kram-p25-v25.plain_english: In proof merged, by Śiva-step-shining-glory-force — body-breath-made, measured-made-knower-standing-formed. When time's cadre reaches Your dissolution-step — then the goddess who shines, mine — she would be Śiva-made.
kram-p25-v25.sanskrit_cite: pramāṇe saṃlīne śivapadalasadvaibhavavaśāt | tadā devī yāsau lasati mama sā syāc chivamayī

kram-p26-v26.plain_english: Manifestation-named consciousness, sequenceless, from void-step, outside-merged — spreads utterly as covering. Then too in inner-essence, by melted rush, sequencelessly — great Time-goddess, making all time.
kram-p26-v26.sanskrit_cite: prakāśākhyā saṃvit kramavirahitā | mahākālī seyaṃ mama kalayatāṃ kālam akhilam

kram-p27-v27.plain_english: Then in the goddess in whom supreme-full-standing-enjoying — sequence cut, quickly, standing-minded-taste reflecting — proof, knower, measure, then whole world this standing embraced — may my mind resort to this consciousness.
kram-p27-v27.sanskrit_cite: kramaṃ vicchidyāśu sthitimatirasāt saṃvidadhati | śrayatu mama cittaṃ citim imām

kram-p28-v28.plain_english: Unobstructed, in self-made Lord, in great Lord — abide, pervading powers. That power-possessor, I venerate — god, churn-named, world-one-essence.
kram-p28-v28.sanskrit_cite: anargala svātmamaye maheśe tiṣṭhanti | taṃ śaktimantaṃ praṇamāmi devaṃ manthānasaṃjñaṃ jagadekasāram

kram-p29-v29.plain_english: Thus own-power-ray-mass-praise-bonds heard — Lord, if You come to grace — by that quickly all folk, by own-rule-rays, darkness-masses allayed — make ye.
kram-p29-v29.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svaśaktikiraṇaughanutiprabandhān ākarṇya | nijaśāsanāṃśu saṃśāntitākhilatamaḥpaṭalāṃ vidheyāḥ

kram-p30-v30.plain_english: In the sixty-sixth year, on the ninth dark day, in Mārgaśīrṣa, by me Abhinavagupta, Śiva was praised.
kram-p30-v30.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭṣaṣṭinām eke varṣe navamyām asite | mayā 'bhinavaguptena mārgaśīrṣe stutaḥ śivaḥ

essence: Completion-rite amid sorrow; mirrored mind drops fear.

sections.SUMMARY: Amid sorrow's host, the finishing rite in spreading bliss-taste: by mutual doing the mirrored mind drops fear.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: sorrow's crowd, bliss spreading, fear gone. Opening relished.

essence: Redoubled self-scrutiny: effortless standing in hymn.

sections.SUMMARY: Examined and re-examined, the self stands effortless in hymn at every knowing-moment.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: examined twice, standing always. Effortlessness relished.

essence: Unscrutinized sterility vs shining Śiva one-sapped: bliss follows scrutiny.

sections.SUMMARY: Without scrutiny no knowing; Śiva shining one-sapped makes the devotee ever blissful.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: unscrutinized nothing, scrutinized Śiva. Vindication relished.

essence: Omniscience effortlessly gained; heart bidden to speak the hymn.

sections.SUMMARY: Wandering gears yield omniscience without strain; the heart must speak it clear now.

rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at gained omniscience to be spoken
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: won without strain, speak it now. Injunction relished.

essence: Bond-conceit shaken, difference burnt, glory drunk: madness-bliss.

sections.SUMMARY: Bond-roads shaken off, difference praise-burnt, glory's rush drunk to madness-bliss.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is intoxicated joy: shaken, burnt, drunk, blissful. Madness relished.

essence: Unhymnable held, hymned sudden: bowing first means.

sections.SUMMARY: Conduct held makes hymning impossible yet done — sudden bowing the first means.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wondering exultation: unhymnable, hymned. Suddenness relished.

essence: Fire-unburning nobodies; knowing-rays praised each-owned.

sections.SUMMARY: Strip burning, no body stands; praise rays, each owned and praising.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: stripped fire, praised rays. Dissolution relished.

essence: Unpartitioned taste, unopposed floods, priceless knowing.

sections.SUMMARY: Melted rule yields unpartitioned taste; unopposed floods bear priceless knowing.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: rule melted, taste unequalled. Sweetness relished.

essence: Difference-fled form; heart-and-speech vowed.

sections.SUMMARY: Form shines difference-gone; heart and speech-instruments vowed unabandoned.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: form seen, instruments vowed. Enlistment relished.

essence: Inner ocean; triple lights rise-set at once.

sections.SUMMARY: Alone-within ocean throbs; moon-sun-fire rise and set at once.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: ocean within, lights clashing at once. Inward vastness relished.

essence: Power undivided walking; heart one-pointed on still ground.

sections.SUMMARY: His power walks varied-unvaried-beyond stations never parting; the heart prays one-pointed on still ground.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: power walking, heart fixing. Fixing relished.

essence: Whole-to-difference by will; praise melts fear Śiva-made.

sections.SUMMARY: The complete Whole leads its own power into difference by will; priceless freedom praised melts fear into Śiva-made.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wondering exultation: Whole leading, fear melting. Descent relished.

essence: Thisness-form; sequencelessness melts time; all instruments at once.

sections.SUMMARY: Your form is very thisness, power-juiced; sequencelessness melts time-reckoning; every instrument at once.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: thisness, melted time, total standing. Standing relished.

essence: Swelled sequence shown; triple-becoming prayed for overlaying.

sections.SUMMARY: Sequence swollen and measured in Himself shown; triple-named becoming prayed.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shown triple, prayed triple. Becoming relished.

essence: Dissolved emission questioned; moon-answer; ever-sport in mind prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Emission once dissolved fire-formed: where to shine but moon-lovely? Ever-sport in mind.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is love-wonder: dissolved, lovely, sporting ever. Sport relished.

essence: Rush-to-redness resorted; past-loathing prayed in red conclave.

sections.SUMMARY: Outer emit in bliss-taste resorted by rush to red; past-loathing in the red rite.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is passion: rushed, reddened, unloathing. Reddening relished.

essence: Outer quit, noble dwelt, undivided shown; ends grasped.

sections.SUMMARY: Outer work quit for noble ground; nondifference shown waveless; maintenance's and wandering's ends grasped.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: quit, dwelt, shown, grasped. Grasping relished.

essence: Rule-ban shown, Yama emitted, doubt split: grind prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Calm-wished by loosing; rule then ban; Yama made; doubt re-split; grinding prayed.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is fierce exultation: ruled, banned, made, split, ground. Grinding relished.

essence: Melted all but hunger; strike prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Doubt, conduct, glory, rule melted; hunger ungulpable remains; strike.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is fierceness: melted all, hungry still, strike. Hunger relished.

essence: Split difference shines thought; considered maker gracious.

sections.SUMMARY: Goddesses split at once; thought-living shines knower-standing; considered share gracious maker.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peaceful exultation: split, shone, considered, named. Naming relished.

essence: Three obtained ordain unfolding; fear-gone prayed by them.

sections.SUMMARY: Your three obtained by power's spread ordain the varied state by unfolding; fear-gone by them.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: obtained, ordaining, fear gone. Ordaining relished.

essence: Dread-ground held; as-pleased conduct sporting prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Ground held dread-making; conduct at pleasure sporting in heart.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exuberant joy: held dread-ground, sporting conduct. Sporting relished.

essence: Sun-sap forcibly drawn; difference thinned prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Limited measures fail; sun-sap drawn by force; difference thinned.

rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at sun sapped, difference thinned
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: drawn hard, thinned clean. Thinning relished.

essence: Garland re-entered; gracious adornment prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Garland whole entered again in self; gracious heart-path adornment.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is love: entered again, graciously adorned. Adorning relished.

essence: Proof merged, measure stood; time met: Śiva-made shining.

sections.SUMMARY: Merged in proof, stood in measure; time-cadre met in dissolution — shining Śiva-made.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: merged, stood, met, shone. Meeting relished.

essence: Cover spread without; time made within.

sections.SUMMARY: Without merged, cover spread; within melted, time made by Mahākālī.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wondering exultation: spread cover, made time. Making relished.

essence: Sequence cut in fullness; all embraced; resort prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Full goddess cuts sequence; all embraced standing; mind resort to knowing.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: cut, embraced, resorted. Resort relished.

essence: Powers abiding unhindered; churn-essence bowed.

sections.SUMMARY: Unhindered abiding in self-made Lord; churn-named one-sap bowed.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: abiding seen, churn bowed. Bowing relished.

essence: Heard bonds; grace coming; all-folk bidden allayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Praise-bonds heard; grace coming prayed; all-folk allayed bidden.

rasa.sthayibhava: karuṇotsāha at darkness allayed for all
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is compassion-exultation: heard, graced, allayed. Grace relished.

essence: Dated authorial seal, 991 CE.

sections.SUMMARY: Sixty-sixth year, ninth dark, Mārgaśīrṣa: Abhinavagupta praised Śiva.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: dated, signed, done. Sealing relished.

lines: Amid sorrow's crowd, the finishing rite — bliss-essence spreading;
the foul day turns sweet: mirrored in the hymn, the mind drops fear.
kram-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: duḥkhavrātavrataparigame pāraṇavidhir | mahāsaukhyāsāraprasaraṇarase durdinam idam | pratiphalati ceto gatabhayam

lines: Examine the self, then examine again the hymned deed;
in Your hymn I stand — always, effortless.
kram-p02-v02.sanskrit_cite: vimṛśya svātmānaṃ vimṛśati punaḥ stutyacaritaṃ | nikhilaviṣayajñānasamaye taditthaṃ tvatstotre 'ham iha satataṃ yatnarahitaḥ

lines: Unscrutinized, the self knows nothing, is nothing — no grasping, no gain;
but Śiva, self shining, one sap of all — hence bliss in Your hymn always.
kram-p03-v03.sanskrit_cite: anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmā na hi bhavati bhāvapramitibhāj | śivaś cāsau svātmā sphurad akhilabhāvaikasarasas

lines: Through birth-wandering gears, omniscience is won. O heart, no strain;
caught clear in speech, show the Lord's hymn — now.
kram-p04-v04.sanskrit_cite: jātyādibhramaṇaparipāṭīparikarair avāptam sārvajñaṃ hṛdaya | tvadbodhaprasarasaraṇībhūtamahasi sphuṭam vāci prāpya prakaṭaya vibhoḥ stotram adhunā

lines: Shake off the bond-roads, drink deep of things — burnt clean in praise-fire;
mad-drunk on glory's rush, O giver — bliss is mine.
If the heart already holds His conduct, how sing at all?
Yet it is hymned, suddenly: bow to Śiva-oneness, the first means.
kram-p06-v06.sanskrit_cite: hṛdayam adhiśete yadi tataḥ | kathaṃ stotraṃ kuryād | śivaikātmyaprāptau śivanatir upāyaḥ prathamakaḥ

lines: Flame-shaped, glory-ripe — strip burning from fire, what body stays?
None. I praise knowing's rays — each owned, each praising: His power displayed.
kram-p07-v07.sanskrit_cite: jvaladrūpaṃ bhāsvatpacanam atha dāhaṃ prakaṭanam | stuve saṃvidraśmīn yadi nijanijāṃs tena sa nuto

lines: Where beginnings vary and rules have melted, what taste is there, unpartitioned,
full past compare? Self's light-yoke is one with all that is; floods unopposed, knowing supreme, past price.
kram-p08-v08.sanskrit_cite: vicitrārambhatve galitaniyame yaḥ kila rasaḥ | sakalabhavabhāvaikamayatāviruddhair dharmaughaiḥ paracitir anarghocitaguṇā

lines: Varied, giver, Your form shines — own-portioned, this world, difference fled;
to praise it, heart and speaking-songs be mine — rush unabandoned, evermore.
kram-p09-v09.sanskrit_cite: vividhaṃ te kila vapur vibhāti svāṃśe | tad evaitatstotuṃ hṛdayam atha gīrbāhyakaraṇaprabandhāś

lines: Deep within You alone, glory throbbing, ocean knowing, waves tasting free,
they rise and set at once: moon, sun, fire, creation, keeping, loosing, one gleam.
kram-p10-v10.sanskrit_cite: tavaivaikasyāntaḥ sphuritamahaso | sṛṣṭisthitilayamaya sphūrjitarucāṃ śaśāṅkārkāgnīnāṃ yugapad udayāpāyavibhavāḥ

lines: Hence His power walks — varied, unvaried, beyond difference — ever,
never parting, nohow: so on this still ground, Bhairava, Your step — may my heart-ground fix one-pointed there.
kram-p11-v11.sanskrit_cite: vibhoḥ śaktiḥ śaśvad vrajati na vibhedaṃ katham api | tadekāgrībhūyān mama hṛdayabhūr bhairava vibho

lines: From the brimming Whole — oh, taste spilling joy — You lead Your power
into difference, by will's own spreading; priceless, Your freedom — praising Your wonder-become power, fear melted, I am Śiva-made.
kram-p12-v12.sanskrit_cite: nijāṃ śaktiṃ bhedaṃ gamayasi nijecchāprasarataḥ | anarghaṃ svātantryaṃ tava

lines: Just thisness — Your form, power-juiced; where sequence fails,
time-reckoning melts by force. By mind, speech, senses, pots — may I stand that form at once, unceasing.
kram-p13-v13.sanskrit_cite: idantāvad rūpaṃ tava bhagavataḥ śaktisarasaṃ | tadrūpaṃ yugapad adhitiṣṭheyam aniśam

show always in Yourself, O god. Then triple-named — doing, knowing, willing, may I become triple, heart eager to overlay.

lines: Once dissolved, fire-formed emission — where would it shine, joy-beyond-facing?
Moon-touched, lovely, fire-and-moon-powered — Bhairava, may Your emission play ever in my mind.

they ordain by order, by opening, the varied world-state; by them, devoted-hearted, fear gone may I be.

lines: Where doing-mind-measures fail, on the narrow step — spreading wide, then drawing in by its own gleams —
she who saps the stationed sun entire: draw hard, thin my difference, free me from world-fear.
kram-p23-v23.sanskrit_cite: sphāraṃ nijanijarucā saṃharati yā | iyaṃ mārta.ṅdasya sthitipadayujaḥ sāram akhilam

lines: O whole garland, sequenceless, entered in self again and again,
ray-heaped within without end. Supreme, bliss to grasp, eager, noble — gracious to me be she; adorn the heart-path.
kram-p24-v24.sanskrit_cite: samagrām akṣālīṃ kramavirahitā sātmani muhur | prasannā me bhūyāt hṛdayapadavīṃ bhūṣayatu ca

lines: When proof has melted into Śiva-step-shining glory — body-breath measured into knower-standing —
when time's frame meets Your dissolving step — then she who shines, mine, would be Śiva-made.
kram-p25-v25.sanskrit_cite: pramāṇe saṃlīne śivapadalasadvaibhavavaśāt | tadā devī yāsau lasati mama sā syāc chivamayī

lines: Called manifestation, knowing — sequenceless, from void's step merged without —
spreading sheer as cover. Then within, rush melted, sequence-free: great Kālī, making all time, mine.
kram-p26-v26.sanskrit_cite: prakāśākhyā saṃvit kramavirahitā | mahākālī seyaṃ mama kalayatāṃ kālam akhilam

lines: Then in her — supreme, full, standing, enjoying — cut sequence short,
quick, taste standing-mindedness: proof, knower, measure, world entire embraced — may my mind resort to this knowing.
kram-p27-v27.sanskrit_cite: kramaṃ vicchidyāśu sthitimatirasāt saṃvidadhati | śrayatu mama cittaṃ citim imām

lines: Unhindered, in the self-made Lord, great Lord, wide powers abide;
that power-bearer I bow — god, churn-named, the world's one sap.
kram-p28-v28.sanskrit_cite: anargala svātmamaye maheśe tiṣṭhanti | taṃ śaktimantaṃ praṇamāmi devaṃ manthānasaṃjñaṃ jagadekasāram

lines: Thus — these praise-bonds of Your power's ray-mass heard — Lord, if grace comes —
quickly by Your rule-rays make all folk, darkness allayed.
kram-p29-v29.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svaśaktikiraṇaughanutiprabandhān ākarṇya | nijaśāsanāṃśu saṃśāntitākhilatamaḥpaṭalāṃ vidheyāḥ

lines: In the sixty-sixth year, ninth of the dark fortnight —
in Mārgaśīrṣa, by me, Abhinavagupta, was Śiva praised.
kram-p30-v30.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭṣaṣṭinām eke varṣe navamyām asite | mayā 'bhinavaguptena mārgaśīrṣe stutaḥ śivaḥ

lines: Amid sorrow's crowd, the finishing rite — bliss-essence spreading;
the foul day turns sweet: mirrored in the hymn, the mind drops fear.
kram-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: duḥkhavrātavrataparigame pāraṇavidhir | mahāsaukhyāsāraprasaraṇarase durdinam idam | pratiphalati ceto gatabhayam

lines: Examine the self, then examine again the hymned deed;
in Your hymn I stand — always, effortless.
kram-p02-v02.sanskrit_cite: vimṛśya svātmānaṃ vimṛśati punaḥ stutyacaritaṃ | nikhilaviṣayajñānasamaye taditthaṃ tvatstotre 'ham iha satataṃ yatnarahitaḥ

lines: Unscrutinized, the self knows nothing, is nothing — no grasping, no gain;
but Śiva, self shining, one sap of all — hence bliss in Your hymn always.
kram-p03-v03.sanskrit_cite: anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmā na hi bhavati bhāvapramitibhāj | śivaś cāsau svātmā sphurad akhilabhāvaikasarasas

lines: Through birth-wandering gears, omniscience is won. O heart, no strain;
caught clear in speech, show the Lord's hymn — now.
kram-p04-v04.sanskrit_cite: jātyādibhramaṇaparipāṭīparikarair avāptam sārvajñaṃ hṛdaya | tvadbodhaprasarasaraṇībhūtamahasi sphuṭam vāci prāpya prakaṭaya vibhoḥ stotram adhunā

lines: Shake off the bond-roads, drink deep of things — burnt clean in praise-fire;
mad-drunk on glory's rush, O giver — bliss is mine.
If the heart already holds His conduct, how sing at all?
Yet it is hymned, suddenly: bow to Śiva-oneness, the first means.
kram-p06-v06.sanskrit_cite: hṛdayam adhiśete yadi tataḥ | kathaṃ stotraṃ kuryād | śivaikātmyaprāptau śivanatir upāyaḥ prathamakaḥ

lines: Flame-shaped, glory-ripe — strip burning from fire, what body stays?
None. I praise knowing's rays — each owned, each praising: His power displayed.
kram-p07-v07.sanskrit_cite: jvaladrūpaṃ bhāsvatpacanam atha dāhaṃ prakaṭanam | stuve saṃvidraśmīn yadi nijanijāṃs tena sa nuto

lines: Where beginnings vary and rules have melted, what taste is there, unpartitioned,
full past compare? Self's light-yoke is one with all that is; floods unopposed, knowing supreme, past price.
kram-p08-v08.sanskrit_cite: vicitrārambhatve galitaniyame yaḥ kila rasaḥ | sakalabhavabhāvaikamayatāviruddhair dharmaughaiḥ paracitir anarghocitaguṇā

lines: Varied, giver, Your form shines — own-portioned, this world, difference fled;
to praise it, heart and speaking-songs be mine — rush unabandoned, evermore.
kram-p09-v09.sanskrit_cite: vividhaṃ te kila vapur vibhāti svāṃśe | tad evaitatstotuṃ hṛdayam atha gīrbāhyakaraṇaprabandhāś

lines: Deep within You alone, glory throbbing, ocean knowing, waves tasting free,
they rise and set at once: moon, sun, fire, creation, keeping, loosing, one gleam.
kram-p10-v10.sanskrit_cite: tavaivaikasyāntaḥ sphuritamahaso | sṛṣṭisthitilayamaya sphūrjitarucāṃ śaśāṅkārkāgnīnāṃ yugapad udayāpāyavibhavāḥ

lines: Hence His power walks — varied, unvaried, beyond difference — ever,
never parting, nohow: so on this still ground, Bhairava, Your step — may my heart-ground fix one-pointed there.
kram-p11-v11.sanskrit_cite: vibhoḥ śaktiḥ śaśvad vrajati na vibhedaṃ katham api | tadekāgrībhūyān mama hṛdayabhūr bhairava vibho

lines: From the brimming Whole — oh, taste spilling joy — You lead Your power
into difference, by will's own spreading; priceless, Your freedom — praising Your wonder-become power, fear melted, I am Śiva-made.
kram-p12-v12.sanskrit_cite: nijāṃ śaktiṃ bhedaṃ gamayasi nijecchāprasarataḥ | anarghaṃ svātantryaṃ tava

lines: Just thisness — Your form, power-juiced; where sequence fails,
time-reckoning melts by force. By mind, speech, senses, pots — may I stand that form at once, unceasing.
kram-p13-v13.sanskrit_cite: idantāvad rūpaṃ tava bhagavataḥ śaktisarasaṃ | tadrūpaṃ yugapad adhitiṣṭheyam aniśam

lines: You swell sequence on that ground, mete Your powers' difference —
show always in Yourself, O god. Then triple-named — doing, knowing, willing, may I become triple, heart eager to overlay.
kram-p14-v14.sanskrit_cite: kramollāsaṃ tasyāṃ bhuvi viracayan | trirūpaṃ bhūyāsaṃ samadhiśayituṃ vyagrahṛdayaḥ

lines: Once dissolved, fire-formed emission — where would it shine, joy-beyond-facing?
Moon-touched, lovely, fire-and-moon-powered — Bhairava, may Your emission play ever in my mind.
kram-p15-v15.sanskrit_cite: purā sṛṣṭir līnā hutavahamayī | taveyaṃ sṛṣṭyākhyā mama manasi nityaṃ vilasatām

lines: When in the outer emit, in utmost bliss-taste, You rush to redness —
then, red goddess, make me past loathing of the red-drinking rite.
kram-p16-v16.sanskrit_cite: yadā tatraiva tvaṃ bhajasi rabhasād raktimayatām | kriyād raktāpānakramaghaṭitagoṣṭhīgataghṛṇam

lines: To quit outer work, to dwell in noble knowing-ground —
show things undivided, waves gone fickle; grasp, goddess, maintenance's end, then grasp ever my wandering state's undoing, Lord.
kram-p17-v17.sanskrit_cite: bahir vṛttiṃ hātuṃ citibhuvam udārāṃ nivasituṃ | sthiteḥ sāṃsārikyāḥ kalayatu vināśaṃ mama sadā

lines: To still the world by loosing it — rule of doubt-fear, then ban —
You show, having made Yama. Split doubt again, great goddess, grind my world-fear fine.
kram-p18-v18.sanskrit_cite: jagatsaṃhāreṇa praśamayitukāmaḥ | mahādevī seyaṃ mama bhavabhayaṃ saṃdalayatām

lines: Doubt melted, conduct gone, glory gone, rule gone —
to gulp the endless feast entire, greed-juiced, O dissolution-named, strike my heart's split part.
kram-p19-v19.sanskrit_cite: vilīne śaṅkaughe sapadi paripūrṇe ca vibhave | saṃhārākhyā mama hṛdi bhidāṃśaṃ praharatu

lines: So by goddesses, difference-glory split at once — thought-living one shines, knower-standing. Enough.
Considered in my own heart, dissolution-formed, gracious be she — my death-loosing maker, blessed.
kram-p20-v20.sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ devībhiḥ sapadi dalite bhedavibhave | mṛtyupralayakaraṇī me bhagavatī

lines: So Your three — by own power's spread obtained, six-wheeled, stationed —
they ordain by order, by opening, the varied world-state; by them, devoted-hearted, fear gone may I be.
kram-p21-v21.sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ te tisro nijavibhavavisphāraṇavaśād | kramād unmeṣeṇa pravidadhati citrāṃ bhavadaśām

lines: This ground she holds, dreadful in splitting world fear;
this wake-fixed melted taste — ordained too. Holding, melting, wiping the foul stretches, conduct at pleasure — sporting in my heart.
kram-p22-v22.sanskrit_cite: imāṃ rundhe bhūmiṃ bhavabhayabhidātaṅkakaraṇīm | bhajati lasatāṃ sā mama hṛdi

lines: Where doing-mind-measures fail, on the narrow step — spreading wide, then drawing in by its own gleams —
she who saps the stationed sun entire: draw hard, thin my difference, free me from world-fear.
kram-p23-v23.sanskrit_cite: sphāraṃ nijanijarucā saṃharati yā | iyaṃ mārta.ṅdasya sthitipadayujaḥ sāram akhilam

lines: O whole garland, sequenceless, entered in self again and again,
ray-heaped within without end. Supreme, bliss to grasp, eager, noble — gracious to me be she; adorn the heart-path.
kram-p24-v24.sanskrit_cite: samagrām akṣālīṃ kramavirahitā sātmani muhur | prasannā me bhūyāt hṛdayapadavīṃ bhūṣayatu ca

lines: When proof has melted into Śiva-step-shining glory — body-breath measured into knower-standing —
when time's frame meets Your dissolving step — then she who shines, mine, would be Śiva-made.
kram-p25-v25.sanskrit_cite: pramāṇe saṃlīne śivapadalasadvaibhavavaśāt | tadā devī yāsau lasati mama sā syāc chivamayī
